findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hospital_prices, medicare_partd_coverage, distill_status · Private data: tax_sales_rate, tax_sales_rate_batch, hospital_prices, medicare_pfs_rate, medicare_partd_coverage, drug_nadac, drug_nadac_search, sanctions_address, distill_status · Public sink: tax_sales_rate, tax_sales_rate_batch, hospital_prices, medicare_pfs_rate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hospital_prices, medicare_partd_coverage, distill_status · Private data: tax_sales_rate, tax_sales_rate_batch, hospital_prices, medicare_pfs_rate, medicare_partd_coverage, drug_nadac, drug_nadac_search, sanctions_address, distill_status · Public sink: tax_sales_rate, tax_sales_rate_batch, hospital_prices, medicare_pfs_rate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
